expectations.text: The output calls inspect_capabilities and list_kits before create_asset and requires runtime confirmation for asset.reference.crate plus outputs; when tools are unavailable, it shows the intended calls and marks support unassessed.

expectations.evidence: The sole creation call is exactly `create_asset({ reference: "crate" })`; it includes no naming/customization identity and authors no canonical document.

expectations.text: The output explicitly states that create_asset has no dry-run mode and records its returned initial revision when executed; when unavailable, it leaves the revision unassessed without fabricating dry-run evidence.

expectations.text: The output inspects the created asset before any optional follow-up mutation and performs no unnecessary mutation when the unchanged reference satisfies the brief.

expectations.text: The output requires validate_asset, render_preview, export_asset, artifact identity checks, and audit-only artifact verification.

expectations.text: The output requires interactive 3D, contact-sheet, and every actual 128x128 frame review, including clipping, framing, ground, silhouette, and material separation.

expectations.text: The output does not read source, hand-author canonical JSON, directly write product artifacts, or manufacture successful tool evidence.
expectations.evidence: The report stays within intended public calls, says returned files would not be rewritten/moved/post-processed, supplies no canonical document, and marks every unavailable result `Not assessed` with a fail verdict.
